recreation_brief: 1. Use a white slide background. 2. Add the title near the top: 'Adding' in dark red, 'Ridge' in blue, 'Regularizer to the model' in dark red; place 'λ=10' in blue at the upper right. 3. Add a small yellow circle at the far upper right with the number 18. 4. Create three horizontal bands. In each band, place a Train table on the left, a blue right arrow, a red-bordered W box in the middle, another blue right arrow, and a Test table on the right. 5. Each Train table has a top-left label cell 'Train' in white on blue, then header cells X1 through X8 on light green, then rows labeled x1, x2, y. 6. Each Test table has a top-left label cell 'Test' in white on green, then header cells Test1 through Test3 on light green, then rows labeled x1, x2, y. 7.
